sections.title: ☁️ Cloud & Infrastructure
sections.summary: Kubernetes supports rolling updates for improved deployment safety, allowing gradual replacement of old pods with new ones to avoid downtime. This default deployment strategy is essential for production workloads, ensuring applications can be deployed safely. Kubernetes also integrates with GitOps tooling for fully automated deployments based on config file changes, removing manual errors. Advanced rollout strategies like canary and blue-green deployments can be implemented using tools like Argo Rollouts for stronger safety in critical services. Rolling updates are part of a broader set of practices in Kubernetes DevOps, including version control, automated testing, and automated rollbacks.
